== Title ==
<span lang="ja">キフェックス</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここに自分の宇宙船がちょうど2つだけいる場合には、合計戦闘力に＋2。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここに自分の宇宙船がちょうど2隻だけいる場合には、合計戦闘力に＋2、場に出ている「トニカ・シスターズ」の各数値とアイコンの数が2倍になる。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Kiffex]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Light uses the general counter 2つ; Dark uses the ship counter 2隻. Dark doubles each printed number and icon count of Tonnika Sisters on table; English says Tonnika Sisters anywhere are doubled.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-kiffex.gif|Original English face]], [[Kiffex]].</ref>
